title: 16-field fixed-header policy risk scorer (mid-function join points)
task_summary: Implement and verify `header_score`: evaluate 16 distinct per-byte policy rules over a 16-byte header `h` (`n == 16`) and return the sum of all 16 rule weights (`spec.header_score(h)`). Notice that 16 sequential branches produce 2^16 = 65,536 paths unless merged with acyclic mid-function `place { ... }` join points (without `decreases`).
contract_header:
use spec = "header_score_spec.ode"

fn header_score(h: n bytes, n: number)
    requires n == 16
    returns spec.header_score(h)
    trace depends on h, n
    stack 0
